leadText: Megumi Toyoguchi (Japanese: 豊口めぐみ Toyoguchi Megumi) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Megumi Toyoguchi (Japanese: 豊口めぐみ Toyoguchi Megumi) is a Japanese voice actress for . 

==Biography==
Toyoguchi was born on January 2, 1978 in , , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined during the original series and started out voicing various characters of the day, doing so all the way into . Toyoguchi's most prominent role came during , where she voiced , one of . In 2016, it was revealed that she is married and pregnant. In 2017, she gave birth to a baby son. Toyoguchi is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
